newsitem.title: USA: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA wheat export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 192,400 metric tons (MT) were 27 percent below the previous week and 39 percent below the 4-week average.

Major increases reported for the Philippines (58,300 MT), Russia (25,000 MT), Japan (24,900 MT, reflects 41,800 MT in new sales and 16,900 MT in cancellations), and China (19,300 MT) were partially offset by reductions for unknown destinations (21,800 MT). Net sales activity of 86,900 MT for the 1997/98 marketing year were primarily for Israel (39,900 MT), Panama (23,700 MT), and El Salvador (19,000 MT).

Exports of 398,900 MT were off 45 percent from the week earlier and 12 percent from the 4-week average. The principal recipients were the Philippines (79,300 MT), Yemen (61,300 MT), Egypt (52,500 MT), South Korea (50,900 MT), and Japan (44,300 MT).
